page.overview:
Who is Tsumegeri Guards?

The Tsumegeri Guards were four of the most powerful soldiers in the Arabasta Kingdom Guard Squad. They drank the Hero Water and attempted to take down Crocodile, but failed and died from the water's side effects shortly after Crocodile refused to even fight them to give them an honorable death.

The Tsumegeri Guards wore the armor similar to the regular Arabasta Kingdom Guard Squad soldiers but with the addition of a turban with a duck headband and wings on each sides. They wear what appears to be war paint, with one line that goes down to the nose as their common mark.

The Tsumegeri Guards were fiercely loyal for their country and ruler, as they were willing to drink the Hero Water in an attempt to even the odds against Crocodile, knowing full well of the lethal side-effects.
